name: microservice-example
description: Three-tier microservice example: Angular console, Express customer-service, SQLite.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix services/customer-service && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix services/customer-service" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix services/customer-service && npm test --prefix frontend
